description: Gets a Grand Prix weekend by league code and slug, such as f1 and monaco-grand-prix: where it is held, every session with its start and end time, each session's classification once it has one, and the winner of every other edition. Answers "what time is the Monaco Grand Prix", "when is qualifying" and "who won last year".

code.description: The league's code, in any case.

season.description: The edition's year; null for the current season's, else the latest.

slug.description: The meeting's evergreen slug, such as monaco-grand-prix.

name: get_meeting

editions.description: Every edition of the meeting, newest first, with its race winner.

trackUrl.description: The circuit's outline as raced that season, never another season's; null when it isn't drawn.

winner.description: The race's winner, once it is classified.

abbreviation.description: The timing-screen code, such as LEC.

fastestLap.description: In a race or sprint, the session's fastest lap (1:22.167) on the car that set it; null on every other car.

part.description: In qualifying, the part its best lap was set in and its place decided: Q3, Q1, SQ2.

status.description: classified, dnf, dns, dsq or nc.

time.description: In a race or sprint, the winner's time or another car's interval to it (+12.594, +1 Lap); in practice or qualifying, the car's best lap (1:13.978).

entrants.description: The teams entered in the edition's sessions: whom a calendar of the weekend follows.

round.description: Its round in the season; null for an edition called off.

sessions.description: Every session of the edition in start order, each with its whole classification.

endTime.description: When it is due to end; null when the provider gives no length.

lap.description: While a race or sprint is live, the lap the leader is on, when the provider counts it.

laps.description: While a race or sprint is live, the laps it is planned to run.

meetingSlug.description: The meeting's evergreen slug, such as monaco-grand-prix.

name.description: The stage as an event names it, such as Qualifying.

places.description: The classification, first place first, as far as the page shows it; empty until there is one.

abbreviation.description: The timing-screen code, such as LEC.

fastestLap.description: In a race or sprint, the session's fastest lap (1:22.167) on the car that set it; null on every other car.

part.description: In qualifying, the part its best lap was set in and its place decided: Q3, Q1, SQ2.

status.description: classified, dnf, dns, dsq or nc.

time.description: In a race or sprint, the winner's time or another car's interval to it (+12.594, +1 Lap); in practice or qualifying, the car's best lap (1:13.978).

stage.description: The stage's code, such as qualifying or race.

state.description: scheduled, live, final, cancelled or postponed.

trackUrl.description: The meeting's track outline, its mark on a card; null when that season's circuit isn't drawn.
The circuit's outline as raced this edition, the meeting's mark; null when it isn't drawn.

region.description: Its state or region, read as a game's venue reads it (Of).

title: Grand Prix weekend
